items.label: JCET IR activity record: 2026-10-12 (10-12-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Management (IR record, meetings July-September 2026; CFO Lia

set.signal: Management (IR record, meetings July-September 2026): the 2026 fixed-asset investment budget is about RMB 100 hundred million, aimed at capacity expansion (focused on advanced packaging, plus mainstream packaging capacity per customer orders) and R&D (mainly computing and automotive electronics). H1 2026 capex was RMB 47 hundred million, up nearly 80% year over year, mostly in advanced packaging, modules and test, with high-end advanced packaging more than half. It is expanding the Jiangyin high-end advanced packaging plant and announced in June a second high-end advanced packaging plant in Shanghai Lingang; capacity is being expanded this year with a larger release next year. At the Lingang automotive plant new capacity quickly reached full load, and because demand exceeded expectations the company added automotive-grade wafer-level packaging capacity there, expected to start production next year.

items.label: JCET IR activity record: 2026-10-12 (10-12-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Management (IR record): the company is optimistic on the cyc

set.signal: Management (IR record): the company is optimistic on the cycle, driven by long-term structural change from AI infrastructure; back-end and especially high-end packaging and test is becoming the industry's bottleneck. Domestic market investment in AI has significantly exceeded original expectations, and advanced packaging demand is growing faster than expected; overseas foundries' advanced packaging projects are spilling over; AI demand in H2 will exceed H1 and advanced packaging capacity is expected to stay in tight balance for the next few years. Domestic plants are running at full load while new capacity is validated; utilization at the overseas STATS ChipPAC plants will rise further in H2 with the mix shifting toward data centers; the company has a price-linkage mechanism with increasing customer acceptance. The Korea plants are being transformed toward AI, with the two Korean plants' resources integrated; results are expected to show clearly from H2 2026 through the next two years, extending their end markets from communications to AI compute, power and storage.

items.reason: The source speaks of the domestic market's AI investment (投入) exceeding original expectations significantly, not 'demand far exceeding'.
items.evidence: 当前国内市场对 AI 的投入已显著超出原有预期， 先进封装需求随之超预期增长。

items.label: Sinopack investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-15-2026)
items.signal_prefix: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: silicon photonics

set.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: silicon photonics chips generally need ceramic substrates in packaging, and it supplies core ceramic products (ceramic housings and substrates) to domestic and overseas optical-module companies; thin-film substrates, with advantages in surface flatness and metallization-layer thermal stress that help long-term reliability and heat dissipation of silicon-photonics modules, 'occupy the main position' in 1.6T optical modules (company view), while thin-film and DPC substrates are different technology routes.

items.reason: The answer describes thin-film substrates as a technology route holding the main position in 1.6T modules; it does not say the company's own thin-film substrates hold it.
